title: LobeHub A2UI Extensions
description: LobeHub's extensions on top of the A2UI basic catalog, aligned with the official A2UI playground catalog (CopilotKit, MIT): headings and sections, KPIs, data views, charts and feedback, drawn with @lobehub/ui and @lobehub/charts in their a2ui look. Every word shown comes from the Agent. Icon names reach a bundled set of Lucide icons.

Heading.description: Surface title with optional eyebrow and subtitle. Start most surfaces with one.

Section.description: Titled group with eyebrow, title, description, and children.

Title.description: A heading in a Card or next to another component; a heading alone is markdown. Size "2xl" at most once per surface, "lg" for sections. "sm" is an h4, "md"/"lg" an h3 (default "md"), "xl" and up an h2. Bold unless strong is false.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Caption.description: Small secondary text: a hint under a control, or a label in a Row. `text` can have inline markdown.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Markdown.description: A block of GitHub-flavored markdown. Use it only next to other components, for example in a table cell or next to a chart. Markdown alone goes outside the fence.

Stat.description: One numeric KPI: label, short value (number or <10 chars like '$84k'), optional delta (e.g. '+4.2%'), caption. Not for sentences.

StatGroup.description: Compact strip of several KPIs in one card.

Sparkline.description: Tiny trend with label and latest value; a compact KPI with history, fits in a Grid instead of Stat. values: numbers.

DataTable.description: Sortable, filterable table (TanStack Table). columns [{key,label,format?}], rows are objects keyed by column key.

KeyValueList.description: Label/value rows, e.g. specs or order details.

Timeline.description: Vertical timeline of dated events or steps with status.

Agenda.description: Calendar agenda: days with timed events (conference, week plan, schedule). Prefer over Timeline for clock times.

ComparisonTable.description: Feature matrix comparing options side by side. options are the option names as strings; rows [{feature, values}] with one value per option, in the same order, each true/false/text; highlight is the recommended option's index in options (0 is the first).

Progress.description: Labelled progress bar, value 0-100: goals, budgets used, completion, coverage.

RadialProgress.description: Ring with centered value, value 0-100: a single score or percent complete.

Rating.description: Star rating (0-5) with optional review count: products, places, reviews.

Avatar.description: Person avatar (initials if no image) with name and subtitle: authors, owners, reviewers.

text.description: An emoji or a name's initials, when there is no image.

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping avatar stack with +N overflow: attendees, team members, reviewers.

Badge.description: A small status pill. Use the colors success, danger and warning only to show a status, not for decoration.

LineChart.description: Trend over ordered x. data [{x,y,series?}]; one line per series.

AreaChart.description: Filled trend for volumes or cumulative totals (traffic, signups); series stack. data [{x,y,series?}].

BarChart.description: Compare categories. data [{x,y,series?}]; series grouped side by side, or stacked:true. horizontal for long labels.

PieChart.description: Part-to-whole. data [{label,value}]; donut:true for a ring with center total.

ScatterChart.description: Relationship between two numbers (price vs rating, effort vs impact). data [{x,y,label?,size?,series?}].

RadarChart.description: Multi-axis profile (scores per criterion for 2-3 options or people). data [{axis,value,series?}], values on a shared scale.

Heatmap.description: Matrix of values, e.g. day x hour. data [{x,y,value}] with x,y categories.

Gauge.description: Half-ring gauge for a single value within min..max (score, utilization).

SankeyChart.description: Flows between stages, e.g. budget or funnel paths. links [{source,target,value}].

Alert.description: Inline alert with icon, title and message.

Callout.description: Highlighted tip or note with optional emoji/icon and a call to action.

onAction.description: Fires when the call-to-action button is clicked.

level.description: Semantic level; sets colour and icon.

EmptyState.description: Empty or zero-results state with icon, title, hint and optional action: no matches, nothing scheduled, inbox zero.

onAction.description: Fires when the action button is clicked.

CodeBlock.description: Syntax-colored code with language label and copy button. Use for any code, config, command or diff snippet.

Quote.description: Pull quote with attribution: testimonial, review, reviewer comment.

Kbd.description: Keyboard shortcut chips, e.g. keys ['Cmd','K'] with a label. Use for shortcuts and how-to steps.

Link.description: A link. Only http, https and mailto URLs work. It opens in a new tab.

LinkCard.description: A preview of a URL: favicon and domain, title, description, thumbnail. A click opens it in a new tab, or sends onClick when bound. For sources, articles and products with a page.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the card, instead of the link.

domain.description: Shown next to the favicon. Default: the host of href

Accordion.description: Collapsible items (FAQs, details, per-file notes); each has a title and either text or a child id.

Card.description: A card around one child; nested, a filled tile. With an action (openUrl to its page) the whole card is clickable.

child.description: The ID of the single child component to be rendered inside the card. To display multiple elements, you MUST wrap them in a layout component (like Column or Row) and pass that container's ID here. Do NOT pass multiple IDs or a non-existent ID.

action.description: Optional. Runs when the card is clicked or activated from the keyboard: usually {"functionCall": {"call": "openUrl", "args": {"url": "https://…"}}}. Don't also put a Button for the same action inside.

Grid.description: Children in equal columns, e.g. two options side by side or a set of small cards.

columns.description: Columns, 2–4 (default 2). They stack when the card is narrow.

Icon.description: A small muted line icon by a basic name, or a Lucide icon as 'lucide:<name>' (e.g. 'lucide:rocket'). An accent beside a heading or label, never the content itself; no brand logos.

name.description: The name of the icon to display: a basic name, 'lucide:<name>', or an svgPath.

anyOf.description: A Lucide icon, written 'lucide:<name>'. Only these names are bundled; others are rejected: activity alarm-clock archive arrow-down arrow-down-right arrow-left arrow-right arrow-up arrow-up-right award badge-check ban battery bell bell-off book book-open bookmark bot box brain briefcase bug building building-2 cake calculator calendar calendar-check calendar-days camera car chart-area chart-bar chart-column chart-line chart-pie check check-check chevron-right circle circle-alert circle-check circle-dot circle-help circle-pause circle-play circle-user-round circle-x clipboard-list clock cloud cloud-rain cloud-sun code coffee coins compass copy cpu credit-card crown database dollar-sign download droplet ellipsis ellipsis-vertical eye eye-off fast-forward file file-text film filter fingerprint-pattern flag flame flask-conical folder gauge gift git-branch git-commit-horizontal git-merge git-pull-request git-pull-request-arrow globe graduation-cap hammer hand-heart hard-drive hash headphones heart heart-off heart-pulse history hourglass house image inbox info key keyboard languages laptop layers layout-dashboard leaf lightbulb link list list-checks list-todo loader lock lock-open log-in mail map map-pin medal megaphone menu message-circle message-square mic monitor moon mountain music newspaper package palette paperclip pause pencil percent phone phone-call piggy-bank pin plane play plug plus printer puzzle receipt refresh-cw repeat rewind rocket rss save scale school search send server settings share-2 shield shield-alert shield-check shopping-bag shopping-cart skip-back skip-forward smartphone smile sparkles square star star-half star-off store sun tag target terminal thermometer thumbs-down thumbs-up ticket timer trash-2 tree-pine trending-down trending-up triangle-alert trophy truck tv umbrella upload user-round users utensils video volume-1 volume-2 volume-off volume-x wallet wand-sparkles wifi wind workflow wrench x zap

List.description: A list in a Card or next to another component; a plain list of text is markdown. Give "items": an item with a value and no action is a key-value row (Price: $1,599). Or give "children": ListItem ids or a template. With "action" the user picks an item; the event context gets its index, label and value.

value.description: Without an action: shown on the right of the label, for a key and value fact. With an action: the payload of the pick, not shown

action.description: Runs when the user picks an item. The args are the index, label and value of the item.

maxMarkerSize.description: The width of the marker column in pixels

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

ListItem.description: An item of a List, with a label, a value on the right, a description, an icon and children. With an "action", the user can pick it.

value.description: Without an action: shown on the right of the label, for a key and value fact

action.description: Runs when the user picks the item.

marker.description: Shows this text as the marker

markerSize.description: The width of the marker column in pixels

disabled.description: Greys the item out and ignores its action

EntityCard.description: A card for one product, place, person or listing: image, title, subtitle, description, a price or meta line, badge, rating and up to three buttons. href opens a page; onClick is sent when bound. Use a Grid of them for several things.

actions.description: Up to three buttons. A button without href sends onAction with its label

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab

onAction.description: Sent when the user clicks a button without href. The args carry the label of the button.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the card and it has no href.

subtitle.description: A second line, for example the brand or category

meta.description: A short fact line, for example "$29 / month" or "Open until 22:00"

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab when the user clicks the card

layout.description: Default "vertical". "horizontal" puts the image on the left

FollowUp.description: Suggested next prompts as pills; a click sends the pill's message as the user's next turn, no event needed. At the end of a surface, two to four short items.

message.description: The text sent when the user clicks. Default: label

onFollowUp.description: Sent when the user clicks a pill. The args carry the message of the pill.

Citation.description: An inline source marker ([1]) showing title, snippet and link on hover or click. Put it right after the sentence it supports, as a child of a Text or in a Row.

label.description: Marker text instead of the number, for example a domain

snippet.description: The quoted passage, one or two lines

source.description: The publisher or domain. Default: the host of url

Form.description: A layout container that is a form. It sends onSubmit when the user submits (a Button with submit true, or Enter in a field). Put its field values in the event context with { "@path": "/x" }.

onSubmit.description: Sent when the user submits the form.

label.description: A short name of the form for screen readers

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Label.description: The label of a form field.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Select.description: A dropdown list of options. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read the chosen option. Give it a label.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

value.description: Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user entered

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

clearLabel.description: The label of the empty option

icon.description: Lucide icon shown before the value

RadioGroup.description: A group of radio buttons. The user chooses one option. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read it. Give it a label.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

value.description: Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user entered

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

Radio.description: One radio button. Use RadioGroup instead, because it keeps the chosen value.

SegmentedControl.description: A row of segments. The user chooses one option. Use it for 2 to 5 short options. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read it.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

value.description: Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user entered

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

TextArea.description: A multi-line text input. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user typed. Give it a label.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

value.description: Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user entered

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Switch.description: On/off toggle with label and description.

ChipSelect.description: Multi-select chips bound to a string-list path: extras, interests, dietary needs.

DatePicker.description: Date picker with calendar popover; value ISO date bound to a path.

Combobox.description: Searchable dropdown for long option lists (countries, cities, timezones).

ButtonGroup.description: Segmented single-choice control; value bound to a path.

Tooltip.description: Shows `content` when the user points at or focuses `trigger`. `trigger`: one child id, a Text, Icon or Badge (not a Button or Link). `content`: one child id of short text, no links or buttons.

Popover.description: A small overlay: exactly two children, one PopoverTrigger then one PopoverContent. A click on the trigger toggles it; Escape or a click outside closes it.

hoverOpenDelay.description: Milliseconds before a hover opens it. Default 0

PopoverTrigger.description: The trigger of a Popover. Its children are the label of the trigger: a Text or an Icon. Do not put a Button in it, because the trigger is already a button.

PopoverContent.description: The body of a Popover. It shows only when the Popover is open.

sideOffset.description: Pixels between the trigger and the content. Default 6

Carousel.description: A horizontally scrolling row that snaps to its CarouselItem or CarouselMediaItem children, with arrows. Bind activeIndex to read or set the slide in view.

activeIndex.description: The index of the slide in view. Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read or set it

label.description: A short name of the carousel for screen readers

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

CarouselMediaItem.description: A Carousel slide: an image with its children (a Caption, a Text) under it. size "sm" 160px, "md" 240px (default), "lg" 320px wide. A click opens all slides full-screen, unless href or onClick is set.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the image. It replaces the full-screen view.

description.description: What the image shows, for screen readers

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab

lightbox.description: Default true: a click opens all slides full-screen

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

ImageGrid.description: A gallery of images in a grid. A click opens the image full-screen, with arrows to the other images. layout "bento" makes the first image twice as large.

href.description: Opens this URL instead of the full-screen view

layout.description: Default "grid". "bento" makes the first image twice as large

Math.description: A TeX math formula, typeset with KaTeX. Set block to true for a centered formula on its own line.

ProfileCard.description: Person card: avatar, name, role, company, location, bio, contacts, tags, stats. Use for team members, speakers, candidates.

EventCard.description: Event: date block, title, time, venue, host, attendees count, tags, RSVP action. Lead an event or conference with it.

onAction.description: Fires when the RSVP button is clicked.

ReceiptCard.description: Order receipt: merchant, order id, date, line items with qty and price, subtotal/tax/total, status.

RecipeCard.description: Recipe: title, time/servings/difficulty, ingredient checklist and numbered steps. Use for any recipe or cooking how-to.

WeatherCard.description: Current weather hero with condition icon, temp, high/low, details, an hourly strip and daily forecast. icon: sun|cloud-sun|cloud|fog|drizzle|rain|snow|storm.

StockTicker.description: Stock quote header: symbol, name, price, change and % change, sparkline, key stats. sample:true labels illustrative data.

MapView.description: Interactive map (MapLibre) with numbered markers; fits all markers. markers [{name,lat,lon,description?}].

LocationCard.description: Single place (venue, hotel, office): mini map, name, address, category, rating, actions. Use instead of MapView for one place.

PlaceList.description: Split view: ranked list of places linked to a map; hovering/clicking a row highlights its marker. selected (row index) starts with that row highlighted.

RouteMap.description: Map with a route line through coordinates [[lon,lat],...] plus start/end pins and distance/duration.

Metrics.description: Headline figures side by side (MetricStrip). They share one row while readable and wrap into balanced rows when not. Not a table.

value.description: The figure as a short string: '667', '1.01s', '¥440'.

tone.description: Whether this is good or bad news; colours the figure.

variant.description: joined: one strip (default); split: separate tiles.

Metrics.$comment: Replaced by StatGroup. Kept so stored cards replay.

type.description: line/area: a trend over time. bar: compare groups. donut: share of a whole (first category). barList: a ranking. scatter: x/y relation (categories = [x, y, size?], index = series). funnel: stage drop-off. radar: several attributes per series. heatmap: daily activity (index = date YYYY-MM-DD, first category = count). tracker: one block per period coloured by its `tone` field (good|bad|warn|neutral), index = tooltip. sparkLine/sparkArea/sparkBar: a tiny inline trend. categoryBar: one bar split into segments.

data.description: Rows of plain values, at most 200.

index.description: Row field on the axis, or the slice / stage / block name.

categories.description: Numeric row fields to draw, at most 4 series.

subtitle.description: One line under the title that states the takeaway, e.g. 'Mobile overtook web in week 46'.

format.description: How numbers read: number (12,400), compact (12.4K), currency (with `currency`, default USD), percent (values 0-100: 12.4 means 12.4%, never fractions).

currency.description: ISO code when format is currency, default USD.

stacked.description: bar and area: stack the series instead of placing them side by side.

Chart.$comment: Replaced by LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, PieChart, ScatterChart, RadarChart or Heatmap. Kept so stored cards replay.

Statistic.description: One prominent figure with its label.

trend.description: Which way the change goes; draws an arrow. The delta is green when up is good, unless tone says otherwise.

values.description: Recent values, oldest first, drawn as a sparkline under the figure when a trend matters. 3 to 60 numbers.

Statistic.$comment: Replaced by Stat. Kept so stored cards replay.

Table.description: Rows and columns read across and down: a comparison of options, a schedule, a price list.

format.description: How the cells read: text (default), number, compact, currency, percent (0-100), or badge (a coloured pill; colours from tones).

currency.description: ISO code for currency cells, default USD.

tones.description: Badge colour per cell value, e.g. {"Active": "success", "Overdue": "error"}.

rows.description: Rows keyed by column key; cells are short strings or numbers. At most 50.

Table.$comment: Replaced by DataTable. Kept so stored cards replay.

KeyValue.description: Facts about one thing as label / value pairs: a profile, a spec, an order, settings.
KeyValue.$comment: Replaced by KeyValueList. Kept so stored cards replay.

Steps.description: Ordered stages with a state each, drawn as a vertical or horizontal stepper.

orientation.description: vertical (default); horizontal for at most 5 short stages.

status.description: The stage's state; drawn as a marker, never as words.

Steps.$comment: Replaced by Timeline. Kept so stored cards replay.

Tag.description: A short label with a semantic colour.

icon.description: Optional Icon name shown before the text (a basic name or 'lucide:<name>').

Tag.$comment: Replaced by Badge. Kept so stored cards replay.

Collapse.description: A section whose content opens from its header.

child.description: The ID of the content shown when expanded.

Collapse.$comment: Replaced by Accordion. Kept so stored cards replay.

Code.description: A block of code with syntax highlighting and a copy button.
Code.$comment: Replaced by CodeBlock. Kept so stored cards replay.

Weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.
